description:
Problem (Advisor-confirmed, reports/Advisor48h.md): (H) _retry_reason (cli.py:1031-1048) returns 'its retry is due' for a same-head pending state before any failure counting; failed runs upload no state, so the head is re-dispatched on every develop push forever and never surfaced (probe test_state_path_redispatches_forever_after_failures). (M) A stateless retry is refused by the previous head's retry budget (retry.py:109-111 counts retries across heads), concludes success, and the PR goes silent. (M) verdict_runs (github.py:301-306) stops at GitHub's 1,000-run cap without error (total_count 1972 for 7 days). (L) Runs are tied to heads by committer date (sweep.py:68-78, author-controlled) and cancelled runs count as failures (sweep.py:14). (L) The stateless-marker branch in the plan never fires for sweep dispatches (dead). (Nit) The plan bypasses the budget on an owner reset while the sweep enforces it (retry.py:107-108 vs cli.py:1045-1047); queued runs count as spending a reset (sweep.py:93-94).

Outcome: same-head state path counts failed runs after state.updated_at and applies the stateless rule (dispatch once, surface on second failure, respect recent_dispatches vs daily_budget); recent_retries counts only the current head; a marked retry the plan refuses exits non-zero; verdict_runs raises when collected < total_count and the query window is narrowed (48 hours or the oldest open head's time); dispatches carry head=<sha> in the run name or input and runs are attributed by that, not committer date; cancelled runs are not failures; dead marker branch deleted; one documented reset rule shared by plan and sweep; queued runs never spend a reset.

Decision gates:
1. Reset rule: implement 'an owner reset ignores backoff and budget once, in both plan and sweep' (matches docs/agent/merge-authority.md); if code constraints force the other reading, stop and ask.
2. If tying runs to heads needs a workflow input change that alters the public dispatch interface for humans, record the new input in docs and proceed; if it needs a ruleset or environment change, stop and ask.

Item guardrails: fail closed (unknown attribution -> do not count as success, do not dispatch more than once per sweep per head); retry budgets and backoff values unchanged; build on #3565's listing code.

FREEZE LIFTED (owner 2026-10-27): the oracle-code merge freeze is removed; PRs merge on the normal rules (oracle SHIP on the exact head, threads answered and resolved, make pr-arm).

Common guardrails: work only in a linked worktree created by make worktree-create, then make agent-write-preflight; the primary clone is read-only. Never use git stash (refs/stash is shared across worktrees). Commit as Joe Harris <joeharris76@gmail.com>, staging explicit paths only; no git add -A, no --no-verify, no SKIP, no agent trailers. Durable text (commits, PR bodies, docs, code) carries no tracker ids, session labels or plan references. Maintained code has no explanatory comments or docstrings (make comment-policy-check). Before publishing run make docs-reference-inventory-check, make doc-contracts-guard and make pr-preflight, and self-review with the code review action, fixing every Critical and Required finding. Publish only with make pr-open: never gh pr create, a raw push-and-open, or a PR-body override line; if make pr-open refuses, stop and report the exact refusal instead of routing around it. Until oracle-omp-pin-single-source-20261026 merges, make pr-open may run only with PATH prefixed by the darwin-arm64 omp 18.12.1 build recorded in that item (SHA-256 fa41b27d434380e99b713e4f9ced0f73eb1fc0c409fdf23a57c119971d24bac5, from https://build.stencil.so/d/omp/20261017-231446-291e055/omp-darwin-arm64), verified with shasum immediately before use; never any other side-loaded omp. Never edit, delete, dismiss or minimise an oracle review, review comment or commit status, and never post a commit status by hand. Run /oracle-review only on a pending or absent head, or after a Dispute: reply with file:line counter-evidence; never to re-roll a decided head. Do not close, reopen, rerun or rebase other PRs. Until oracle-gateway-cloud-builder-access-20261025 merges, publish only from the owner's Mac. Rollback: if a change to the verdict or gate workflows or to the local review breaks its first live run after merge in a way that blocks other PRs, stop, run make trunk-revert PR=<n>, and report to the owner, who chooses between an absence stand-in and the broken-oracle-gate procedure. Never print tokens, keys, or the gateway URL or hostname; never spend model quota outside the review harness. Owner decisions are recorded in context and in the decisions file; a step that would contradict one stops and asks the owner.
